principles: Dense global physical data loads on demand through tiles or provider services.
Physical hydrology is independent from sacred or textual river overlays.
Bare or sparse vegetation is not synonymous with desert or aridity.

entries.label: Terrain
entries.status_note: Elevation and hillshade load only after explicit activation. Provider failure is nonfatal.

entries.label: Water

source.dataset: 1:110m coastline, lakes, rivers and lake centerlines
source.attribution: Made with Natural Earth · public domain

entries.status_note: Generalized world-scale physical-water context from Natural Earth. It is cartographic context, not a legal boundary or drainage-basin authority layer.

entries.label: Hydrology
entries.status_note: Measured physical drainage context. It remains independent from Eden/Four-Rivers sacred or textual overlays.

entries.label: Land cover
entries.status_note: Preserve source classes such as trees, shrubland, grassland, cropland, built-up, bare/sparse vegetation, water, wetland and snow/ice. Bare/sparse vegetation is not the same thing as desert.

entries.label: Deserts / aridity
entries.status_note: Climatic/ecological aridity is a distinct variable from satellite land-cover class and must use its own sourced dataset.
